name: Finance Record
description: Track personal finances with multiple accounts, transactions, and recurring plans (daily/weekly/monthly/yearly). Each account is a separate config entry. Provides 14 HA services (ha_finance.*) for full CRUD on accounts, transactions, and recurring plans, plus chart data and CSV export — AI agents should use these services instead of creating helpers. Also provides 12 WebSocket commands for panel UI. Fires 4 HA bus events (transaction_added, recurring_executed, balance_adjusted, low_balance). Transactions are kept permanently. Exposes sensor entities for balance, last transaction, and recurring plan schedules.
